page.name: Screen::HttpsSettings
page.title: 本机 HTTPS 连接配置
page.entry: One native 配置本机HTTPS action in existing teacher-device management page, available to current Local GlobalAdmin even while Readiness::Unavailable. It navigates, never invokes WebService::set_enabled/begin_pairing.
page.parentTransition: App handles web_editor::Command::OpenHttpsSettings, calls existing leave_web to discard displayed short code and schedule original pairing-window close, then submits a privileged HTTPS load on same pool. Do not silently disable Web logical admission; save rejection ConfigurationUnavailable remains authoritative.
page.returnTransition: Return to teacher-device management through its normal fresh privileged load. No automatic reenable/pairing, no settings navigation from public classroom controls.

fields.name: HOST
fields.label: 域名或 IP（不含 https://、端口和路径）
fields.validation: HttpsHost::parse; ASCII canonical host. Existing IPv4/IPv6 input support conveys no new listener/network readiness.

fields.name: PORT
fields.label: HTTPS 端口（1–65535）
fields.validation: Only decimal ASCII digits; checked u16 and nonzero. Default configuration None renders blank: no invented9443/default port.

fields.name: CERTIFICATE
fields.label: 当前程序用户 MY 证书引用（40位十六进制）
fields.validation: HttpsCertificateRef::parse; no PFX/path/password/private-key/key-container fields or selectable Windows account.

notInInitialSlice: Do not expose implicit configuration=None when a field is empty. If clear-config UI is later required, give it a distinct explicit confirmation and original CAS rather than interpreting incomplete forms as deletion.
No certificate-check action wired until R48 contract freezes; reserve a read-only section under reference field only. No synthetic PASS/readiness/Available and no Enable button promotion.
page.riskConfirmation: With dirty draft or an accepted/unconfirmed original attempt, return/cancel/reload uses an explicit keep draft / leave after acknowledging unknown-result risk choice. There is no implicit save and no statement that abandoning the view cancelled a persisted operation. Read-current confirmation must not silently replace original historical capsule.

controllerState.oneOwner: Editor owner is installation/school+PrincipalId and its current exact captured SessionLease, plus page/App generation and bounded operation serial. FormData supplies neither actor/lease/versions nor commandId.
fields: base: Option<HttpsSettingsState> from an explicit current read
draft: bounded host/port/thumbprint strings; dirty flag
phase: Loading | Editing | Submitting | AwaitingOriginalReturn | Unconfirmed | Querying | HistoricalReceipt | FailedKnownNoCommit
original: Option<OriginalAttempt> with exact immutable full Request, stable owner principal/school, original reviewed base and original command id
pending same original generic App Pending; no second active write/query ticket
controllerState.boundedness: One draft, one original-request capsule, one active ticket. Worker captures only typed request/state and metadata; no native certificate/listener owner or secret in task/output. Use checked allocation_bytes including host.capacity plus own structures; do not blindly assign1024 if dynamic request capacity is larger.
controllerState.commandIdentity: Generate SystemRandom CommandId once at explicit save consent; clone exact immutable request into worker and retain original in controller BEFORE admission. Never regenerate due to timeout, cancellation, unavailable result, lock or query. Query receives that saved Request, not current edited FormData.
controllerState.originalLeaseVersusReauthentication: Every running-job positive delivery requires exact current submitted lease and App/page generation. A locked/expired capsule may remain hidden and owner-bound in volatile memory. Same current Local GlobalAdmin may explicitly query after reauthentication with a new exact lease, but stable school/principal/authEpoch/origin must still match original durable actor; backend alone enforces fingerprint. Different owner cannot display/query/rebind capsule.

dataflow.flow: Capture current local management lease on real native action. Submit Load once. Shared worker checkpoint -> lock Backend -> begin_execution_scope(Arc::new(context.execution_fence())) -> read_https_settings -> checkpoint -> release scoped Backend lock -> metadata-only result. UI never does backend SQL or native IO.

Pure bounded local draft updates only. Capture validation through existing domain parsers; show canonical preview origin only as display. Do not change persisted revision, Web state, runtime generation or listener.

Snapshot both base settings.revision and base.identity_revision from actual loaded state. Build canonical typed config and original command once. Use same SharedPool<Work>; one original submit deadline Instant::now()+90s (existing policy). An explicit Busy rejection means no admission: retain returned same Work/request without executing or changing command identity; show not submitted. Other rejection kinds are explicit failures, never swallowed as Busy.

Original current JobContext checkpoint/fence before backend access and after return. BackendExecution AND-combines current worker fence with outer repository fences, then save_https_settings exact original Request. Backend owns disabled-admission RAII configuration permit until real writer guard release; UI never simulates release or obtains another owner.

Consume only for same exact submitted lease, active page/App generation/operation serial, healthy nonrecovering control and current publication receipt captured AFTER backend operation. Do not compare global publication to semantic identity_revision or retain pre-save publication across own COMMIT. Worker may return current memory-only identity/health publication alongside result for an exact delivery gate. Only fresh successful Save may update base/draft and say 配置已保存；尚未启用教师连接。 No readiness effect.

Any accepted write whose result is missing/suppressed/Cancelled/Deadline/Unavailable/late/indeterminate enters Unconfirmed with original request retained. Cancel only signals original ticket/fence, not rollback or physical completion. Keep original pending accounting until actual worker result/physical completion; do not queue reconciliation while original active task still owns slot. Never automatically save again or rebase its revisions.

Only user 查询原保存结果, current fresh exact local admin lease and new finite read job. Scoped BackendExecution passes CURRENT query JobContext fence, not expired save fence, to query_https_settings_outcome(lease, originalRequest.clone()). It is a read; no disabled owner required and Web logical enabled state does not prevent query. No mutation, file IO, native check or background polling.

Some displays historical original saved outcome and original settings revision separately; it does not become current editable base or prove service readiness. None displays only 未查到原操作结果. It never asserts rollback/not saved and never calls save or regenerates a command id. Original worker/SQL may still be physically ending or recovery may have cleared receipts. Preserve original request/draft; allow another explicit read-only query, or existing risk-confirmed exit/current reload. Current read is labelled separately from historical receipt. Any later new write requires explicit fresh review and consent, never a retry synthesized from None.

Ordinary cancel before admission never saves. After admission cancel wait/job retains unconfirmed original; no 已取消保存 or 未保存 assertion. Existing immediate SessionControl.lock_local/OS callbacks and original JobContext stop fence win; late results cannot show on a new lease/page. On lock hide/detach editor and keep bounded owner capsule, no automatic query. Stop uses existing shared pool drain/join, no new thread/native owner.

errors.effect: Input-specific bounded message; preserve draft; before admission no backend save called.
Keep original review and draft, show current versions changed; require explicit re-read/acknowledge before new consent, never silent CAS refresh and repeat.

Configuration guard unavailable because logical Web enabled or another real writer owner still active; preserve draft and tell user return to device management to inspect/explicitly disable. Do not automatic Web disable/retry owner.
Stop repeat submission for same command; display mismatch and preserve capsule for diagnosis/current read, do not generate new command automatically.
Unconfirmed original result, read-only explicit query only. Distinguish an unaccepted queue Busy from a possibly committed accepted job.

Add explicit new typed branch to application fatal(): current generic matcher lacks HTTPS fault variant. Use existing irreversible gate fault/stop path; never offer positive saved/ready or let unknown bypass health.
No positive outcome; existing local lock/relogin flow and owner isolation. Query may use only newly authenticated current same stable actor, never synthesize a lease.

currentIntegrationGaps: R47 Backend/domain/ports/repository now expose read/save/query, but current native application has no HTTPS page/actions/Work/Outcome integration.
Existing web_editor::Readiness intentionally has only Unavailable in product; its SyntheticFixture variant is test-only and must not be reused to turn ordinary listener/Enable on.
Generic App::submit currently erases rejected task/kind; new HTTPS controller must know not admitted versus accepted/unknown to retain exact command safely.
Generic pending failure path drops completion and may lock; original request/capsule must be kept outside Outcome so cancellation cannot erase reconciliation identity.
Generic error_text/fatal lacks new HTTPS error semantics. Add typed HttpsSettings Faulted handling and accepted-save unknown status, rather than relying only on generic reopen/navigate messages.
Existing automatic Web refresh only belongs to Screen::Web. HTTPS draft/outcome query must have no one-second save/query loop or automatic native certificate check.

requiredButNotRun: Pure editor: default None/blank port; strict host/port/40hex/field whitelist; forms cannot supply revision/actor/commandID; cancel leaves persistent config unchanged.

Pure state: exact original ID and both reviewed versions retained across accepted cancellation/failure/queryNone/querySome; Some cannot refresh CAS; no automatic save; different owner never sees capsule.
Actual shared Work pool/SQLite: valid LocalGlobalAdmin read/save/query, User/Teacher/Web/no-must-change/expired/revoked denied, no UI SQL; one original ticket and no product thread/pool count change.
Queue admission Busy: verify returned same job/request/FnOnce and original submit deadline, no SQL execution. Deadline/nonBusy not swallowed or extended.

Real precommit barriers: cancellation/lock while queued, during writer evaluation and immediately after COMMIT suppress positive old delivery. Then explicit new same stable owner query recovers exact historical receipt with no second mutation; different fields/ID/stable actor mismatch rejected.

Logical Web enabled and retained configuration owner reject write without auto-disable/enable; pure query still allowed under fresh authorization. Confirm revision/command receipt count unchanged by queryNone/Some.

Same-page refresh/current read does not overwrite dirty/unknown draft without explicit choice; own COMMIT publication may deliver once, later authority publication/page generation/new lease discards old result.

Host compile/tests/strictClippy/architecture via parent only after core final freeze; then actual authorized Windows native form navigation/save/cancel/reopen/read-only receipt query and ownership cleanup with source+EXE binding.
Keep ordinary listener disabled, NOT_READY string/Enable/Begin product gates intact; no certificate install/trust/firewall/volume/audio/microphone changes and no fake certificate PASS.
